تفترسين (form VIII)
# تَفْتَرِسِينَ (taftarisīna) /taf.ta.ri.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
# تُفْتَرَسِينَ (tuftarasīna) /tuf.ta.ra.siː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
